name: Mauricio
about: I build websites, APIs and tools with one rule: security is designed in from day one. Astro and TypeScript on the frontend, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL on the backend, Linux underneath. I also run NeTenebrae, a Spanish-language channel about hacking and Linux with 17.5K subscribers.

projects.description: Personal cybersecurity knowledge base: pentesting notes, CTF write-ups and cheatsheets, published as a browsable static site.
My bspwm desktop environment: a tuned Linux workstation with a custom QML status bar and helper scripts.
Fullstack court-booking platform: real-time availability, admin panel and per-user booking history.
My Neovim configuration: LSP, treesitter and the plugins I actually use, kept small on purpose.
